description: Enables the Page History panel in TmNotionEditor — version list, block-level diff view, and restore. The panel is accessible from Page Settings → Page History and is hidden when this provider is not supplied.

methods.name: GetVersionsAsync
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of saved versions for the given page, newest first.

methods.name: GetVersionAsync
methods.description: Loads a specific version including its full block snapshot.

methods.name: RestoreVersionAsync
methods.description: Restores a version by inserting its blocks as the new current state. The previous state is automatically saved as a new version before restoring.

methods.name: CompareVersionsAsync
methods.description: Computes a block-level diff between two versions for the side-by-side diff view.
